name: Custom Metal Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Our metal signs are cut from METAL.
    - Thickness: 1mm.
    - Precision laser-cut custom shape.
    - Smooth edges with a durable finish.
    - Pre-drilled 4mm mounting holes for easy installation.
    - Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in the following sizes:
                       +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm.
                       +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.
                       +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm.
                       +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm.
                       +) 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm.
                       +) 14 x 14 in ~ 35.56 x 35.56 cm.
                       +) 16 x 16 in ~ 40.64 x 40.64 cm.
                       +) 18 x 18 in ~ 45.72 x 45.72 cm.
                       +) 24 x 24 in ~ 60.96 x 60.96 cm.
                       +) 36 x 36 in ~ 91.44 x 91.44 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Available styles:
                       +) RAW: No printing (bare metal surface)
                       +) PRINT: 1-sided printing (front side only)
                       +) PRINT 2 SIDES: 2-sided printing (front & back)
    📌 Note: If your design is solid black, we will use electrostatic powder coating (black finish) instead of UV printing to ensure a smooth, durable, and premium metal look.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Custom wall décor for homes, garages, gardens, and fences.
    - Ideal for welcome signs, family name signs, and business logos.
    - Suitable for indoor display or outdoor mounting.
    - Easy to hang using screws, nails, or hooks.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Personalized gift for housewarmings and new homeowners.
    - Unique décor gift for birthdays and anniversaries.
    - Great for sports teams, hobby enthusiasts, and business owners.
    - A bold decorative statement that adds character to any space 🎁.

 

SPECIFICATION

 

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)

 

  • Packaging: 1x Metal Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
  • When you choose the Raw option, the product will be sent in original color. However, during the production process, there will be scratches on the product, because the metal sign is cut by laser. To ensure the product is received in the best possible way, we recommend choosing printing.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here
  • Check the printing file and mockup images generator guideline video here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
